findings: Demo password in committed config — appsettings.Development.json contains Demo:Password in plaintext and is likely tracked in git. Use user-secrets or add the file to .gitignore.
Orphan no-arg constructor in AppDbContext — bypasses DI and silently uses a hard-coded SQLite path instead of ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection. Remove it.
UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute placement — registered unconditionally; add a comment clarifying intent or move it adjacent to the IsDevelopment block to avoid confusing future maintainers.
DateTime.Now in IValidatableObject — EventDate > DateTime.Now should use DateTime.UtcNow to avoid timezone drift if the server is not in the same timezone as the stored UTC dates.
